transcript_assisted.quality_note: Local faster-whisper tiny transcript. Good enough for summary, not for exact quotes.
transcript_assisted.corrected_summary: The video lists a practical stack for AI influencer creation: use Claude, ChatGPT or Gemini to describe the character and create the base prompt; use a high-realism image generator for first images; use alternative video models when moderation blocks some outputs; use Kling/Hailuo-like tools for cheap animation when the avatar does not need to speak; use Seedance/Google/Grok/Jimeng-like options for talking or cinematic avatar video; use ElevenLabs for voice consistency; and consider aggregators like Magnific or Higgsfield instead of paying many tools separately.
key_takeaways: Plan the character before generating visuals.
Separate tools by job: prompt planning, image generation, animation, talking video and voice.
Cost control matters; paying many tools can destroy margin.
Aggregators can be useful when they reduce tool fragmentation.
Voice consistency is a separate production layer.

workflow_extracted.name: AI avatar production stack
steps: Define character/personality and base prompt with an LLM.
Generate video with the platform/model that fits the use case.
Choose aggregator/platform economics based on margin, not hype.
workflow_extracted.onia_use: Design ONIA service packages and internal SOPs for avatar/UGC/client videos while protecting margins and avoiding unnecessary tool spend.

usable_patterns: separate each tool by production job
include cost-control as a serious business point
turn tool choices into a buying/production guide
best_for: pricing and margin strategy for AI video services
onia_adaptation.sample_onia_hook: Antes de pagar 10 herramientas de video IA, separa el flujo en 5 trabajos.
onia_adaptation.sample_higgsfield_prompt_block: Create a vertical educational video showing an ONIA AI video production stack: planning prompt, character board, image generation, animation path, talking avatar path, voice layer and cost-control dashboard. Clean UI overlays, Spanish captions, founder/operator tone, no copied influencer visuals.
onia_adaptation.adaptation_notes: Useful for ONIA because it reinforces tool orchestration and margin discipline. Avoid influencer/fashion framing for B2B clients; translate to dentists, local businesses, SaaS demos and UGC ads.

not_useful_or_use_with_care: AI influencer/fashion examples are weak for ONIA's B2B offer unless reframed.
Censorship-bypass framing is not client-safe and should not be used in ONIA materials.
Community/course CTA is not our default CTA; ONIA should use audit, demo or guide.
Tool names can change quickly; teach the role of each tool, not a fixed vendor dependency.
notes: Strongest reference in this batch for ONIA economics: separate tools by job and protect margin before selling AI video services.
